requirements.general: SPM/SPMV: At least THREE (3) Credits AND a Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics UEC: At least THREE (3) B’s AND a Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics O-level: At least THREE (3) C’s AND a Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics Certificate in related discipline: 2.00 CGPA AND an SPM Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics SKM (Level 3) in related discipline: ONE (1) SPM Credit AND a Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics STPM or equivalent: C (2.00 CGPA) in any subject AND an SPM Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics STAM: Maqbul AND an SPM Pass in Mathematics or Additional Mathematics Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia
